ABOUT ME

I connect digital marketing with business growth.

I’m YAMI, based in Shenzhen, with approximately three years of overseas marketing experience across hardware, smart home, consumer electronics and lighting. My work connects social content, customer inquiries, buyer qualification and sales communication.

I focus on who content attracts, what a buyer needs, and whether sales has the context to follow up. I’m building on this experience toward more systematic growth marketing and demand generation.
